reasons: Classification is correct: a limitation-of-liability clause exists (Section 7(a)) but contains only a damages exclusion with no monetary cap, so it fails the fallback's material term (mutual cap of 12 months' fees) — a deviation rather than a 'missing' finding, and not a case of over-flagging an acceptable fallback.

The redline is minimal and additive: it leaves the existing consequential-damages sentence untouched and inserts a single new subsection supplying the mutual cap and carve-outs, consistent with the redline guidance to edit rather than rewrite the section.

The cap is genuinely mutual ('each Party'), uses a 12-month basis with the USD 1,000,000 floor per the preferred position, and is not illusory; the adaptation from 'fees paid by Customer' to 'amounts paid or payable under this Agreement' is a justified response to the revenue-share structure where the counterparty pays Customer.

Carve-outs preserve the existing indemnification and confidentiality exclusions and add data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, satisfying the preferred carve-out set; the Section 5 payment carve-out correctly implements the 'payment obligations are not damages' element.

Comment is accurate, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, states the position and confirms indemnities/confidentiality sit outside the cap; deterministic checks all pass.
